Installing dependencies from lock file (including require-dev)
Verifying lock file contents can be installed on current platform.
Your lock file does not contain a compatible set of packages. Please run composer update.

  Problem 1
    - Root composer.json requires php ^8.0 but your php version (7.4.1; overridden via config.platform, actual: 8.5.12) does not satisfy that requirement.
  Problem 2
    - Root composer.json requires PHP extension ext-zip ^9 but the ext-zip package is disabled by your platform config. Enable it again with "composer config platform.ext-zip --unset".

To enable extensions, verify that they are enabled in your .ini files:
    - /etc/php/8.5/cli/php.ini

    - /etc/php/8.5/cli/conf.d/15-xml.ini

Alternatively, you can run Composer with `--ignore-platform-req=ext-zip` to temporarily ignore these required extensions.
